_about: Aggregate results of the recorded pipeline runs. Counts only: no corpus text, titles, topics of individual records, or source-file identifiers appear here. This file is the single source of truth for every number published on the public project page, so the page cannot drift from the system.

_provenance.corpus: Private personal conversation export. Not committed, so a full run is not reproducible by a third party. The aggregates below are.
_provenance.full_run_source: Recorded full-corpus pass with the same code path
_provenance.taxonomy_note: These counts were produced before the private_health calibration fix of 2026-09-14, which stopped the bare tokens health, lab, sleep, weight and pain from excluding ordinary engineering vocabulary such as health check, home lab, sleep mode, weight matrix and pain point. A re-run on the same corpus would therefore return MORE public candidates and fewer sensitive-domain exclusions. The figures are published as the recorded run, not as current behaviour. See tests/test_privacy_fixtures.py.

full_corpus_validators._scope: All 11,336 units. Labels are the three-way validator labels, not the pipeline's four-way decisions. policy_classifier() maps exclude_* to private, public_candidate to public, and skip_low_signal to review, which is why its review count equals skipped_low_signal.

sample_validators._scope: 300-unit calibrated sample. Presidio and spaCy are CPU-expensive, so they are validated on a bounded sample rather than the full corpus.

agreement._scope: Full corpus, across the three full-corpus validators.
